{{Top|leg}}
'''Reaper blades''', also known as '''Harvester Blades''', were huge spinning [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] blades fitted to the front of the [[CD-2 Harvester]]. The array measured twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and stood about the same height as [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]]. Reaper blades were designed to harvest the crop in front of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. However, due to the simple [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual sensor suite]] used by the CD-2, the droid often only focused on the crop ahead of it and ignored unexpected obstacles, such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]] being in the way. Tragic accidents were known to have happened, despite the droid having a remote interface to shut it down in case of emergency.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
